html:
Buenos Aires is the capital and largest city of Argentina, a port on the west bank of the Río de la Plata estuary.

The Spaniard Pedro de Mendoza first founded it in 1536, but the Querandí resisted, food ran out, and it was abandoned. Juan de Garay refounded it in 1580. For two centuries Spain made its trade pass through Lima, so the town lived largely on smuggling, much of it with Portuguese traders and silver from Potosí.

In 1776 it became the capital of the new Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata. Its people beat off two British invasions in 1806 and 1807, and its May Revolution of 1810 began Argentina's break from Spain. For decades it fought the provinces over who should rule the country, until it was made the federal capital in 1880.

Wheat and beef exports and mass migration, mostly from Italy and Spain, made it one of the great cities of the world by 1914. Its port districts gave birth to the tango. It was the home of the writer Jorge Luis Borges, and Pope Francis was born there in 1936.
sum: Buenos Aires is the capital and largest city of Argentina, a port on the west bank of the Río de la Plata estuary.
